## Known limitations of this import

- Only the skill is vendored. Upstream also ships tool-specific integrations this library does not use: Claude, Codex, Cursor and Gemini plugin manifests, an OpenCode command and JS plugin, TypeScript extensions under extensions/, and an eval harness under evals/. None are needed to load the skill, and several would require a Node or TypeScript toolchain this repository does not run.
- Upstream keeps the skill under .cursor/skills/, so it vendors to skills/i-have-adhd/i-have-adhd/. The inner directory name is the skill's frontmatter name, which SK004 requires them to match.
